On every committed modeled handleOracleReport: (1) the AccountingOracle.submitReportData validator-balances push through StakingRouter.reportValidatorBalancesByStakingModule (AccountingOracle.sol:513-517) is stamped strictly before Accounting.handleOracleReport's _stakingRouter.getStakingRewardsDistribution() read (Accounting.sol:277) — the write-router-before-read conjunct is the deployed risk Thomas 2026-09-13 flagged as the real ordering, not just read→mint; (2) the rewardsReadSlot tick is stamped strictly before any nonzero rewardsMintedSlot tick — mint_after_read_discipline is kept as an unregistered sub-theorem of the combined parent. The demoted source_report_before_reward child now uses premise-free sourceTraceRetired; legacy fullReportSucceeds APIs remain compatibility adapters and carry no registered load-bearing premise. Not submitReportData; sharesToMintAsFees is an argument.

theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PAccount1.router_accounting_order_discipline
theorems.doc:
/-- **P-ACCOUNT-1, abstract plane (chantier 3, Thomas 2026-09-13).**

On every committed execution of the modeled `handleOracleReport`, both
orderings on the deployed AccountingOracle → StakingRouter → Accounting →
StakingRouter path hold, read directly from the transaction step clock:

1. **write-router-before-read** — the `AccountingOracle.submitReportData`
   validator-balances push through
   `StakingRouter.reportValidatorBalancesByStakingModule`
   (`AccountingOracle.sol:513-517`) is stamped strictly before
   `Accounting.handleOracleReport`'s
   `_stakingRouter.getStakingRewardsDistribution()` read
   (`Accounting.sol:277`), so fee shares are always derived from the
   just-written module weights, never from stale balances;
2. **read-before-mint** — the `rewardsRead` step precedes any nonzero
   `rewardsMinted` step, so a positive fee is minted only after the read of
   fresh balances (the previously-registered `mint_after_read_discipline`
   above, kept as unregistered sub-theorem).

The ticks are `stampStep`'s reads of the transaction-local `sequenceSlot`
clock (reset at the top of the commit branch), not per-call-site constants,
so this is an ordering claim about execution and not about which numeral
appears on which line. Moving either the `stampStep balancesWrittenSlot`
call below `stampStep rewardsReadSlot`, or `stampStep rewardsReadSlot` below
`stampStep rewardsMintedSlot`, without touching any literal, changes the
tick the moved write records and refutes the corresponding conjunct — see
`write_router_before_read_kill_line` and `mint_order_kill_line` below. -/

theorems.role: registered Verity Executable Contract parent (audit/guarantees.yaml verity.theorem)
theorems.name: LidoSRv3.Audit.Guarantees.PAccount1.verity_tx_simulates_oracle_report
theorems.doc:
/-- **P-ACCOUNT-1, Verity plane.**  `observe` of `handleOracleReport` equals
`sourceView`.

Verity child. `observe` of `handleOracleReport` (balance array + total/flag
slots) equals the independently stated `sourceView`. Not `submitReportData`;
`sharesToMintAsFees` is an argument, not a computed fee. -/
theorems.statement:
theorem verity_tx_simulates_oracle_report
    (i : ReportInput) (sharesToMintAsFees : Nat) (state : Verity.ContractState) :
    observe i ((handleOracleReport i sharesToMintAsFees).run state) =
      sourceView i sharesToMintAsFees

assumptions.risk: Canonical runtime, codehash, fork configuration, and address provenance are unavailable in general; Mock-derived evidence is non-production evidence. Chantier 4 (Thomas 2026-09-13) narrows this for two deployed-runtime fixtures under `fixtures/deployed/` to exact identifiers: `WithdrawalVault_implementation` at `0xfB4521BD151BFB45DB6045D2d07e58e0f597e340` with EIP-1052 codehash `0xd1e0d1b48e4f5abd04bdfd14805366f0cf7946b7bb41b7a5ad8652361f3e3d36` (mainnet, block-independent at any block where the immutable code has not been upgraded — the implementation slot on the WithdrawalVault_proxy `0xB9D7934878B5FB9610B3fE8A5e441e8fad7E293f` points at this deployed runtime, and the runtime is not upgradeable); `StakingRouter_implementation` at `0xDD76927045435C7605cf6f5F978cfb8CABDb5F80` with codehash `0x9cd5d45ddde5f74d3867aa22c98fd79a85df89d202145bc588173d92e00600ec` (same block-independence rationale). Under `ETH_RPC_URL`, the `verify_*_immutable.py` scripts re-fetch and re-verify against the live chain, so a mismatch fails the build; without `ETH_RPC_URL`, they enforce the pinned codehash. For every other contract or configuration under this assumption, the generic reduction stands.
assumptions.justification: This premise isolates an unproved environment or representation fact instead of hiding it in the theorem. Chantier 4 (Thomas 2026-09-13) narrows this for the two deployed-runtime fixtures under `fixtures/deployed/` by recording their exact EIP-1052 EXTCODEHASH (keccak256 of the runtime bytecode) in `audit/artifacts.lock.json`: `WithdrawalVault_implementation` (0xfB4521BD151BFB45DB6045D2d07e58e0f597e340) codehash = 0xd1e0d1b48e4f5abd04bdfd14805366f0cf7946b7bb41b7a5ad8652361f3e3d36, `StakingRouter_implementation` (0xDD76927045435C7605cf6f5F978cfb8CABDb5F80) codehash = 0x9cd5d45ddde5f74d3867aa22c98fd79a85df89d202145bc588173d92e00600ec. That is the exact identifier `EXTCODEHASH <implementation>` on any Ethereum node returns for either implementation at any block where the code has not been upgraded. The `verify_*_immutable.py` scripts (invoked from `make test`) recompute keccak256 of the fixture and reject any mismatch; under `ETH_RPC_URL` they also refetch and re-verify against the live chain.
assumptions.violation_impact: Any guarantee linked to this premise must be re-evaluated if the premise is false.
assumptions.validation: Applies to every guarantee. scripts/check_deployed_code.py reads each proxy implementation slot, hashes the on-chain bytecode and compares the verified source with the pinned lido-core checkout; PROVENANCE.md explains the procedure. Chantier 4 additions: for the two deployed-runtime fixtures the exact EIP-1052 codehash is recorded (see `justification`) and enforced by `scripts/verify_beacon_deposit_immutable.py`, `scripts/verify_consolidation_request_immutable.py`, and `scripts/verify_deposit_thirty_two_ether.py` (all three are `make test` targets). A mismatch between the recomputed keccak256 and the recorded codehash fails the build; `ETH_RPC_URL` enables live re-verification against the current chain state.
assumptions.removal_path: Replace the premise with a machine-checked correspondence theorem or a narrower proved interface. Chantier 4 (Thomas 2026-09-13) narrows the runtime-identity strand for two deployed fixtures to the exact EIP-1052 codehash values above; historical block-number binding and the remaining contracts remain follow-up work.
